name: gizza-ai/extract-hashes
summary: Extract hex hash strings from text, grouped by algorithm.

tool.description: Scan a block of text and pull out every hexadecimal hash/digest string, grouped by the algorithm implied by its length: MD5 (32 hex chars), SHA-1 (40), SHA-256 (64), and SHA-512 (128). Hashes are de-duplicated case-insensitively and kept in first-seen order within each group; set lowercase=false to keep the original casing. Returns the total count and per-algorithm groups.

text.description: The text to scan for hexadecimal hash strings.

lowercase.description: When true (default), normalize extracted hashes to lowercase; de-duplication is always case-insensitive.
